desc:
🏠 Welcome to My Cozy Bunker! 🏠
Get your very own bunker home and make it the coziest place on the server! 🛋️✨

🛒 RAID THE MALL
Grab a cart, race to the Mall and load it up with furniture: couches, gaming setups, pool tables, thrones and more! Then roll it all home. 🏃💨

🎨 DECORATE YOUR WAY
Place, rotate and resize anything. Paint walls and floors with cute wallpapers. Unlock new rooms as your home gets cozier! 🖼️

🌙 SURVIVE THE NIGHT
When the sun goes down, the MONSTERS come out! Get home before dark and watch out for the giant Long-Legs in the parking lot! Survive each night to grow your streak and earn more cash. 💰

🎁 MYSTERY GIFTS
Open gifts at your door for Cozy, Deluxe and LEGENDARY furniture! ⭐

👫 Build with friends, keep up to 6 homes, claim daily rewards and finish quests!

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for more updates!
